_comment: Facts about this adapter that its probe response cannot carry: display names, maturity, and the engine versions CI actually restores from. Everything the probe declares (adapter version, engine id, source kinds, pitr) is read from testdata/probe_response.golden instead — never duplicated here. The capabilities generator fails if the source names below do not match the probe exactly, and the integration suite restores from the image listed under verified, so neither can drift. See docs/capabilities.md.
name: PostgreSQL

sources.pgdump_dir: A directory of pg_dump files; the one whose own header records the newest time is restored
sources.pgdump_with_globals: One pg_dump file plus the cluster globals (roles and grants) loaded before it
